{{Top|leg}}
A '''molecular hook''' was a technology that could be used to affix an item to a different item. [[Roamer-6 breath mask/Legends|Roamer-6 breath masks]] used molecular hooks to attach to [[Goggles/Legends|goggles]] or [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmets]] during use.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> [[Deeve]], a [[Scout/Legends|scout]] with the [[Bureau of Scouting and Exploration Services]], used molecular hooks to attach his [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] to the waistpiece of his [[Suit/Legends|suit]].<ref name="Survey">{{WEGCite|story=A Typical Survey|book=Galaxy Guide 8: Scouts}}</ref>
